payload.text: > I read this as Implementation - inspect workspaceStore tab closing logic, write failing regression test, fix last BrowserTab closure behavior, and verify test passes.

I read this as Fix needed - fix the workspace invariant defect where closing the sole `BrowserTab` left an empty workspace layout instead of creating a replacement terminal tab.

### RED Evidence
Before the fix, running `bun test ui/src/state/workspaceStore.test.tsx` failed deterministically on the regression test:
```
924 |     expect(closeBrowserSpy).toHaveBeenCalledWith("browser-123");
925 |     expect(result.current.state.layout.tabs).toHaveLength(1);
                                                   ^
error: expect(received).toHaveLength(expected)

Expected length: 1
Received length: 0

      at <anonymous> (/Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/ui/src/state/workspaceStore.test.tsx:925:46)
(fail) worktree tab and session isolation > creates a replacement terminal tab and closes browser when closing the sole browser tab [0.75ms]
```

### Fix Summary
In `ui/src/state/workspaceStore.ts`:
- Updated `closeTab` when closing a `BrowserTab`: if `snapshot.layout.tabs.length === 1`, resolve the target worktree (`closingTab.worktreePath` or active worktree), create a replacement terminal tab via `createSpawnedTab(worktree)`, close the native browser via `closeBrowser(closingTab.browserId)`, and dispatch `CLOSE_TAB` with the replacement payload.
- Retained normal browser close behavior when multiple tabs exist (`snapshot.layout.tabs.length > 1`) and preserved pinned-tab guards.

### GREEN Evidence
Running both `bun test ui/src/state/workspaceStore.test.tsx` and Vitest:
```
bun test ui/src/state/workspaceStore.test.tsx
 22 pass
 0 fail
 439 expect() calls
Ran 22 tests across 1 file. [642.00ms]

cd ui && npx vitest run src/state/workspaceStore.test.tsx
 ✓ src/state/workspaceStore.test.tsx (22 tests) 45ms
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  22 passed (22)
```

### Changed Files
- `ui/src/state/workspaceStore.ts`
- `ui/src/state/workspaceStore.test.tsx`
